usage.result_excerpt:
The interpreter is in `main.rs` and compiles with no warnings. It reproduces all four spec examples exactly, including the parse-error and runtime-error exit codes.

I also spot-checked a few edge cases by hand:
- `(- 5)` gives `-5`, and `(% -7 2)` gives `-1`, so `%` takes the sign of the dividend.
- `(* 1000 1000000000000)` gives exactly `10^15`, which is allowed; the overflow check only fires ab
